expr: vA = var(A); vA1 = var(A, 1); vA2 = var(A, 0, 2); v_all = var(A, 0, 'all'); v_vec = var(A, 0, [1 2]); v_w = var(v8, W); v_om = var(v, 0, 'omitnan'); v_inc = var(v, 0, 'includenan'); v_s1 = var(5); v_s1n = var(5, 1); v_se = var([7]); v_e0 = double(isnan(var([]))); v_ne0 = numel(var([])); v_ec = var(zeros(0,3)); v_er = numel(var(zeros(3,0))); vMw = var(Mw, wc); vMw1 = var(Mw, wc, 1); vMd2 = var(Mw, [1 3], 2);
comment: Sig: V = var(A[, w | W][, dim | 'all' | vecdim][, nanflag]). w in {0, 1} or vector W (weighted; denominator = sum(W)). 'all' / full-flatten vecdim flatten input. Default nanflag = includenan (NaN poisons; matches MATLAB R2025b for double). Single-element variance = 0 for BOTH N-1 (default) and N normalizations (NOT NaN from 0/0): var(5)=0, var([7])=0, var(5,1)=0. EMPTY var -> NaN (not 0x0): var([])=NaN scalar; var(zeros(0,3))=[NaN NaN NaN] (1x3); var(zeros(3,0))=1x0. Closes audit/findings/stats/var.md + DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-29 n==1 + empty fixes. DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31: weight VECTOR on a MATRIX now reduces per-slice along the operating dim (was: threw 'weight vector length must match number of elements' for default dim, and 'weight vector with non-flat dim not yet supported' for explicit dim). var(Mw,wc)=[2.2222 2.2222] (1x2, dim 1 default), var(Mw,[1 3],2)=[0.1875;0.1875;0.1875] (3x1). N-D weighted reduction still deferred. (NOTE: var([1 2 3],0,1) should be [0 0 0] but a separate core reduce-along-singleton-dim bug returns scalar 1 — deferred, also affects sum/mean.)
